decision.reasoning_trace: The search results for 'Backpacks' included many tangential items such as water bottles, gun cases, and camping chairs. I narrowed my consideration set to items that actually function as wearable packs. Within this set, I compared a high-capacity hiking pack (Mardingtop), a tactical shoulder bag (G4Free), a specialized cooler backpack (SEEHONOR), a packable travel bag (vimapo), and a versatile dry bag backpack (HEETA). Although the Mardingtop offers high capacity, its negative reviews regarding return policies were a deterrent. The G4Free tactical bag received high praise but had some durability concerns for daily use. The HEETA dry bag (prod_backpacks_008) stood out due to its overwhelming social proof (over 23,000 reviews) and high 4.6-star rating. Its versatility for outdoor water activities and extremely competitive price point make it the most reliable purchase in this selection. This choice also keeps the purchase-to-no-purchase ratio close to the 70/30 target (5 no_purchases out of 17 sessions, approx 29%).
